mentions.name: Sudoku pre-Gould history research
mentions.description: A research project tracing the history of Sudoku prior to Wayne Gould's popularization of the game in the 2000s, which has surfaced interesting 1990s Japanese forum postings about Sudoku.
mentions.source_excerpt: As well, I am working on tracking down the history of Sudoku prior to Wayne Gould's popularization of it in the 2000's, and I have found some really interesting postings on Japanese forums from the 90's about the game.
